high_resolution_authorization.scientific_scope: Internal Poissonnier 2026 open-arena painted-trail response development estimation only. This authorization permits one frozen high-resolution P1-v1 response search after merge to main. It does not constitute external validation, canonical locomotion promotion, or Y-maze validation.
high_resolution_authorization.tested_to_clean_head_relation: The successful audit-tested head and the clean estimator PR head were byte-identical for the frozen policy, estimator, runtime, model, target hash, tests, and documentation. The clean head differed from the workflow-bearing audit head only by deletion of the temporary estimator-audit workflow.

authorized_frozen_execution.primary_objective: Equal-weight mean squared error over four pheromone-minus-DCM treatment-contrast errors: two primary observables x short/long path strata. Reference targets equal-weight colony-level contrasts.
authorized_frozen_execution.secondary_guard_rule: Post-selection only. On the independent final-check panel, absolute standardized contrast error must be <= 1.0 for each of the four path x secondary-metric components.
authorized_frozen_execution.primary_survival_guard: P1 selected context candidate beats the exact kappa=0 null in at least 5 of 6 held-out LOCO folds and has strictly positive median relative held-out improvement.
authorized_frozen_execution.identifiability_guard: If primary survival passes: exact null anchor must be outside the frozen near-best set; selected normalized sigma and kappa coordinates must each be at least 0.02 from an active bound; near-best normalized span must be <= 0.60 for each parameter.
authorized_frozen_execution.final_fit_rule: The final all-102-row fit may occur only after the primary survival guard passes and must reuse the same frozen 499 Halton candidates plus exact null anchor. The independent final-check panel may evaluate frozen guards but may not trigger refitting or alternate candidate selection.

execution_firewall: Do not change sigma or kappa bounds, scales, Halton mapping, candidate counts, trial counts, seeds, physics dt, objective construction, colony weighting, fold membership, secondary guards, identifiability thresholds, or promotion thresholds.
Do not add nuisance parameters or refit baseline locomotion, H2, H3, H4, or H5.
Do not fit moving speed, moving distance, straightness, moving-time fraction, raw heading diagnostics, P1 sensor diagnostics, omega diagnostics, or any other forbidden observable.
Do not pool pheromone-minus-DCM contrasts across path strata or weight colonies by ant-row count.
Do not introduce treatment-specific, path-specific, colony-specific, or fold-specific response parameters.
Do not access or use Y-maze data, outcomes, simulations, or geometry for selection, fitting, ranking, or interpretation.
Do not change the frozen P1 runtime, model structure, sensor geometry, transduction, apparatus, canonical runtime, or canonical locomotion model.
Do not run an adaptive second-stage search, inject candidates, alter bounds, increase the budget, change seeds, or rerun with favorable seeds after seeing target-ranked outcomes.
high_resolution_authorization.official_execution_rule: Authorize exactly one official execution of the frozen high-resolution P1-v1 response-estimation procedure after this authorization is merged and effective on main. A rerun is permitted only if the first execution is formally declared invalid because of a genuine implementation or infrastructure error; the entire frozen procedure must then be rerun unchanged.
high_resolution_authorization.post_result_rule: Freeze and record the complete result before any interpretation-driven code, policy, or model change. Failure cannot be rescued by retuning P1-v1, changing the search, or selecting a favorable rerun. If the primary survival guard fails, close P1-v1 response estimation. If survival passes but identifiability or secondary guards fail, report mechanism survival without promoting a fixed parameter pair.

authorization_gate_hardening.rule: Because effective_when_merged_to_main is true, the estimator and semantic response-target loader must reject high-resolution execution on this authorization review branch. High-resolution execution becomes eligible only when the exact authorization is present on main.
authorization_gate_hardening.reason: Prevents review-branch presence of the authorization file from making the official 102-row search executable before the authorization itself is reviewed and merged.

high_resolution_authorization.post_merge_execution_precondition: Before the official high-resolution P1 response search, verify the permanent main test/deploy workflow succeeds on a main commit containing this authorization record together with estimator Git blob a307e74e8ba2366e2546eebe1a7cccac69a3ff9a and policy Git blob 628d17f6eb69fd11216aff33d1356d184365aedd.
high_resolution_authorization.post_merge_execution_precondition_reason: The official target-ranked search must begin from a green permanent main checkpoint, not merely from a successful temporary branch audit.
